caption: The drawing depicts a bird perched on a branch, surrounded by dense foliage and flowers. The bird, positioned slightly to the left of the center, has a brown body with subtle touches of red and green on its wings and tail. It is facing to the left. The background is filled with large, overlapping leaves in shades of green and brown, as well as flowers in white, red, and pink colors with green centers. The composition includes a variety of leaf sizes and shapes, including broad, arching palm-like leaves above and smaller, rounded leaves interspersed throughout. The flowers are clustered mostly towards the lower and right side of the image, while the upper part is dominated by the overhanging branches. The overall color palette is earthy, with muted browns, greens, and deep reds on a light beige or tan textured background. The drawing is bordered by a plain, off-white margin, and the lower left corner has the printed text "JV LUBRANO."
